parts.content: Work in D:\PropelExp. Implement the frontend portions of attached EP-004 US-026 through US-030 and the user-approved minimum React/Vite scaffold. Use the authoritative HTML wireframe .propel/context/wireframes/Hi-Fi/wireframe-SCR-006-poc-authoring.html and design tokens from .propel/context/docs/designsystem.md. Aesthetic: utilitarian clinical workflow, exact semantic palette/token mapping, IBM Plex Sans, 248px desktop rail, 4px controls, 8px surfaces, responsive 1440/768/375 behavior. Create frontend package.json/package-lock, strict tsconfig, Vite config, index, src/main.tsx/App. Required named components: frontend/src/features/poc-authoring/GeneratePocAction.tsx, PocDraftView.tsx, PocValidationSummary.tsx, GroundedClaim.tsx, MissingInformationMarker.tsx, MissingInformationEditor.tsx, PocReadiness.tsx, PocEditor.tsx, PocSaveStatus.tsx; add PocSection if useful. Create shared TypeScript API contracts/client mapping the backend endpoints already implemented. Required behavior: confirmed-only generation with explicit blocked reason; coalesce pending clicks; one unapproved draft; exactly five ordered sections; validation errors for missing/empty/unknown/reordered responses; rejected output not shown completed; grounded claims with navigable support refs; unsupported markers not factual styling; generic guidance normal; named marker/readiness blocking; replacement/removal submits current revision; user-edited origin; editing all five stable sections; retain local edits on failed save; retry and conflict reload. Accessibility WCAG AA: labels, live/alert regions, visible focus, 44px targets, semantic landmarks. Use CSS modules or scoped feature CSS, semantic CSS custom properties, no inline layout styles, no decorative gradients/orbs, no nested cards. Add Vitest + React Testing Library component/integration tests covering each behavior. Inspect backend POC JSON model first. Use current official compatible dependencies available in npm; if the taskâ€™s future exact versions are unavailable, use latest compatible stable and report. IMPORTANT: use apply_patch for edits, make a small first edit then immediately run focused validation, preserve unrelated files, do not edit task markdown or design reports yet, do not commit. Run npm install, focused tests, full tests, typecheck, build. Return concise files, versions, commands/results, blockers.
